sources.quote: While the piston is at a specific point, T.D.C. (the end of the compression stroke) the compressed air-fuel mixture is ignited by a spark plug (in a gasoline engine) in an Otto cycle or by heat generated by high compression (diesel engines), forcefully returning the piston downwards to a point (B.D.C in an Otto cycle).

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: In this stroke the intake valve must be in the open position while the piston pulls an air-fuel mixture into the cylinder by producing a partial vacuum (negative pressure) in the cylinder through its downward motion.
